distinct_mechanism: Original iterate/iterate_profiled pass a stack three-float array to async HtoD before the same graph/eager sweeps. Pageable staging may synchronize on this driver; this is not measured here and no headroom bound is claimed.

official_sources.scope: Async pageable transfers may synchronize/stage; other transfers should be async. Any API may block. This does not prove current baseline timing or speedup.
cuMemcpyHtoDAsync accepts registered or wholly unregistered host regions; same-stream ordering retained.
Struct fields drop in declaration order; first-owned guard must drain before host staging and CUDA fields release.

proposal: Two disjoint three-float slots inside the existing pinned h_staging, no extra pinned/device/event/stream/graph allocation. Compute original CPU Discounts unchanged; queue same d_disc copy on original stream. After two used slots, synchronize before either is overwritten. Tiny staging<6 retains original path. A first-field stream-owning guard drains on destruction/error/unwind; full/strategy readback already synchronizes before staging reuse and resets slot count.
alias_lifetime_requirements: Form only the selected three-float mutable window from raw pointer; do not create a mutable slice over another in-flight source slot.
Mark a slot used before submitting so an error cannot incorrectly permit reuse.
Guard must be the first GpuSolver field; no GpuSolver Drop trait is required, keeping existing by-field moves legal.
Full/strategy readback drains before writing staging; continuation staging replacements are constructor-time/fresh or explicitly synchronized, and continuation upload path remains original.
costs_and_limits: Host control metadata/Arc reference only; report size and test before adoption.
At most two queued ordinary iterations per pinned batch; stop/drop behavior and complete-process wall time need checking, not just scored solve time.
No resource/speed guarantee from documentation. Driver may already stage cheaply; explicit every-two waits and API overhead may cancel any benefit.
No factor/batch-size sweep after an outcome.
required_controls: Exact raw GPU/CPU state against copied accepted original iterate and profiled iterate, after unsynchronized batches, checks, readback/materialization/resume and locks.
F32/compressed, iso/full/compact, DCFR/CFR+; actual tiny fallback.
Injected error after queued copy and normal/panic drop; trace drain and immediate stream readiness before field release.
Fresh feature/GPU builds, ordinary suite and fixed complete-cycle screen at current1%/no-tradeoff gate; full-process wall evidence before adoption.
